rows.name: create makes exact snapshot and preserves unrelated input records
invalid original store is always rejected before a command
all command kinds enforce exact keys and strict IDs, tokens and time
invalid quote, guest or snapshot cannot be stored
existing identity and cross-record operation reuse cannot overwrite records
update preserves creation and snapshots independent deep-copy values
missing records, malformed revisions and revision conflict are separate
cancel preserves quote and guest while changing only local request state
applied update and cancel retry are recognized before stale revision or status
time cannot move backwards and past historical trips can be cancelled
store and revision limits do not corrupt existing history
malformed replay commands cannot bypass exact-key,revision or payload validation
an already applied create remains idempotent at full store capacity
